lines.speaker: scammer
lines.text: Hello, this is Officer Daniel Morgan with the Internal Revenue Service, badge number 4 4 7 1 9.

lines.speaker: scammer
lines.text: Ma'am, our records show you owe three thousand four hundred dollars in back taxes, and a warrant has been issued for your arrest.

lines.speaker: scammer
lines.text: You must settle this today or the police will be at your home within the hour. Do not hang up and do not tell anyone about this call.

lines.speaker: scammer
lines.text: The only way to stop the warrant is to go to the store right now, buy gift cards for the full amount, and read me the numbers on the back.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Sorry dear, I dropped the phone. Who did you say this was?

lines.speaker: scammer
lines.text: This is the IRS, ma'am. You need to buy the gift cards right now. Stay on the line with me.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Gift cards... are those the ones with the little cat on them? My Whiskers would like those.

lines.speaker: scammer
lines.text: Ma'am, focus. When you have the cards, call me back directly at 2 0 2 5 5 5 0 1 4 7 and read me the codes.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Let me find my pen, dear. Was that a seven or an eleven?
